egress_rules._cite: IBC 2021 §1006.2.1 / Table 1006.2.1 — distance from the most remote point in a space to where an occupant FIRST gains a choice of two paths. 100ft=30.5m sprinklered, 75ft=22.9m not. The evaluator uses the UNSPRINKLERED figure unless real sprinkler evidence is found, matching this file's own over-flag-never-under-flag bias.
egress_rules.name: common_path_of_egress_travel

egress_rules._cite: IBC 2021 §1007.1.1 — where two exits are required they shall be placed not less than one-half the maximum overall diagonal dimension of the area served apart; one-third where sprinklered throughout per §903.3.1.1/§903.3.1.2. A RATIO of the diagonal, not a distance, so it carries no _m threshold.
egress_rules.name: exit_remoteness
